expl: Salah. 'why have they land developers changed their plans' adalah embedded question (noun clause) setelah 'not sure' — subject dan verb TIDAK boleh ditukar, seharusnya urutan normal tanpa auxiliary di depan subject.

ref: Never in the world I bel
expl: Salah. 'Never' di awal kalimat adalah ekspresi negatif yang memicu inversion — seharusnya subject dan helping verb ditukar: 'Never in the world did I believe that this would happen'.
Benar. 'had the sun been out a little more' adalah reduced conditional (inversion) dari 'if the sun had been out a little more' — 'if' dihilangkan dan 'had' ditukar ke depan subject.
Benar. 'Only once' adalah ekspresi pembatas di awal kalimat yang memicu inversion, dan 'did the judge take' sudah benar ditukar.

ref: Down the Hall to the lef
expl: Salah. Ekspresi tempat 'Down the hall to the left' memicu inversion verb+subject — seharusnya '...are the offices that need to be painted', bukan 'the offices are that need to be painted'.
Benar. Kalimat tanya utama 'Did the scientist explain' sudah benar di-invert, dan 'what he put in the beaker' adalah embedded question yang benar TIDAK di-invert.
Salah. 'Hardly ever' adalah ekspresi negatif di awal kalimat yang memicu inversion, seharusnya 'Hardly ever does it snow...' bukan 'Hardly ever it snows...'.
Benar. 'than had any other player in history' adalah inversion opsional setelah comparison ('more points than'), subject dan helping verb ditukar dengan benar dan agreement-nya (singular) sesuai.
Benar. Ekspresi tempat di awal kalimat bersifat opsional untuk di-invert — kalimat dengan urutan subject-verb normal ('earthquakes occur') tetap benar.
Salah. Kata 'ever' mengindikasikan conditional yang 'if'-nya dihilangkan — seharusnya subject dan 'should' ditukar: 'Should he ever call again, please tell him...'.
Benar. 'Rarely' di awal kalimat memicu inversion verb+subject: 'Rarely are observatories located...'.
Benar. Setelah connector 'why' (embedded/noun clause), subject dan verb TIDAK di-invert: 'why diets differ around the world'.
Benar. 'Were' di awal klausa adalah reduced conditional (dari 'if...were not spending'), diikuti subject + 'not spending' (bentuk -ing sesuai idiom 'spend money V-ing').
Benar. 'Nowhere' di awal kalimat memicu inversion verb+subject: 'Nowhere are retail trade figures more skewed...'.
Benar. Perbandingan kesetaraan formal 'as...as' dengan inversion: '...as large as is the second smallest country, Monaco' (as + verb + subject).
Benar. Setelah 'when' (klausa keterangan waktu biasa, bukan pemicu inversion), subject dan verb tetap urutan normal: 'when it combines with other elements'.
Benar. Setelah 'nor' (kata sambung negatif), subject dan helping verb WAJIB ditukar: 'nor will trade unionism be treated'.
Benar. Reduced conditional (dari 'if milk should test positive'), 'if' dihilangkan dan 'should' ditukar ke depan subject: 'Should milk test positive...'.
Benar. Ekspresi tempat 'Located behind' di awal memicu inversion, dan subject 'the two lacrimal glands' (jamak) butuh verb 'are': 'Located behind each eyelid are the two lacrimal glands'.
Benar. 'Only for a short period of time' di awal kalimat memicu inversion do-support: '...do cheetahs run at top speed'.
